quote: Build me a small app called Home Ledger that keeps track of everything in my home, with a paid pro version.

cap: Talk asks before it spends anything.

say: An Opus planner splits the app into parts, and Haiku agents take them, each on its own copy of the code.

quote: Add a dark mode to the app.
cap: Mid-build: Talk asks before it sends a request to the agents.

say: The dark mode lands on top of the rest while the other agents work; collisions are redone on the newest code. All ten parts landed in twenty-one minutes, for about two dollars of model time.

cap: Where the time went, agent by agent.
